models.name: Lil Buddy
models.description: The Murdey Little Buddy Surfboard is very similar to the Bells & Whistles model only slimmed down in volume, width and thickness. Takayama inspired nose rider, nose patch/belly/V bottom concave, thinner rails and pulled in square tail. Responsive rail to rail with the ability to walk the nose, a great versatile longboard.

models.name: Checkered Egg
models.description: The Murdey Checkered Egg Surfboard is a midsize egg intended to maximize your wave count while providing stability and maneuverability. Great for those smaller days, but also fun when you want to get into bigger waves early. This is one of Murdey's most versatile boards.

models.description: The Murdey Mini Log Surfboard is a classic mini that has all the characteristics of a modern longboard, only scaled down to create smooth paddling on a more maneuverable version.
